packages.trait_effect_summary: TRAIT_GEORGE_WASHINGTON: +50% Great General and domestic Great General rates; Town +1 commerce; Barracks +1 production; Courthouse +2 espionage; Bank +2 gold; Spy +1 espionage; Merchant +1 gold; Wheat +1 food; Horse +1 production; Road +1 commerce.
packages.personality_theme: Peace-weight 8, military 5/growth 2, Free Speech; reluctant to initiate major war, no razing, above-normal espionage.
packages.replacement_package_summary: Continental Line Infantry replaces Musketman (75 cost, Drill I and City Garrison I); Federal Hall replaces Courthouse (+2 culture and +2 espionage in the live entry).
packages.unique_palace_improvement_or_dll_mechani: Trait relies on the extended trait yield tables read by the custom DLL; no unique palace or improvement.
packages.current_strengths: A clear revolutionary army plus federal administration identity with good early-to-midgame continuity.
packages.overlap_or_redundancy: The trait occupies ten economic/military channels and overlaps generic American growth, commerce, espionage, and command identities; it is difficult to read and budget.
packages.historical_fit: Continental infantry and civil administration fit Washington, while the broad resource/Town/Bank bundle is less specific than his military and institution-building record.
packages.ai_and_art_risks: Stock leader/unit art lowers rendering risk. AI can use passive yields, but does not deliberately optimize the scattered resource, specialist, and route bonuses.
packages.recommendation: Retain the UU/UB and Great General core; in the next matrix collapse the long tail to one bounded institutions/logistics channel.

packages.trait_effect_summary: TRAIT_LEADER_GERONIMO: +25% Great General and domestic Great General rates; Combat I to mounted and gun units.
packages.personality_theme: Peace-weight 8, military 5/growth 2, Environmentalism; defensive/high unit build profile copied almost exactly from Sitting Bull.
packages.replacement_package_summary: Three-move Medicine Man scout with Medic I/II and Sentry; three-move Apache Raider with Flanking I/II, Sentry, rival-territory access, hills bonuses and 40% withdrawal; War Council Barracks adds XP, happiness and military production.
packages.unique_palace_improvement_or_dll_mechani: Uses ordinary promotion/leader XML channels; no unique palace or improvement.
packages.current_strengths: Coherent mobile resistance and field-support package; every component reinforces mobility and endurance.
packages.overlap_or_redundancy: Personality is materially redundant with Sitting Bull, and the Raider is carrying many advantages at once.
packages.historical_fit: Mobile raiding and resistance fit Geronimo's documented defense of Chiricahua homelands; the generalized 'medicine man' combat support role should be handled carefully.
packages.ai_and_art_risks: Custom unit/leader art needs in-game animation checks. Copied diplomacy logic may make Geronimo too passive to exploit the raider.
packages.recommendation: Keep the identity; distinguish the AI from Sitting Bull and verify the Raider's total power budget rather than add mechanics.

packages.trait_effect_summary: TRAIT_MONTEZUMA: custom Montezuma promotion to recon, archery and melee units.
packages.personality_theme: Peace-weight 0, military 5/religion 2, Police State; extremely frequent war, high unit production and razing.
packages.replacement_package_summary: Cheap strength-4 Jaguar with Woodsman I; early Sacrificial Altar with priest slots and -90% hurry anger; Aztec Great Palace adds priest production, population and global hurry support.
packages.unique_palace_improvement_or_dll_mechani: Unique Great Palace; trait promotion requires the existing custom promotion/DLL rules but no new contract.
packages.current_strengths: Exceptionally unified conquest, sacrifice, forest warfare and priest economy.
packages.overlap_or_redundancy: Some thematic overlap with other extreme warmongers, but the hurry/priest axis is distinct.
packages.historical_fit: The package captures militarized Mexica state religion, though sacrificial framing should remain precise rather than sensationalized.
packages.ai_and_art_risks: Stock core art is low risk; palace and custom promotion still require tooltip and render smoke coverage. AI already values war and units.
packages.recommendation: No redesign. Validate the palace/promotion help and watch early hurry stacking in later balance tests.

packages.trait_effect_summary: TRAIT_HAMMURABI: -35% civic upkeep.
packages.personality_theme: Peace-weight 8, culture flavor 10, Bureaucracy; peaceful, non-razing builder with moderate unit production.
packages.replacement_package_summary: Bowman gains +50% versus melee; Royal Palace adds yields, commerce, Great Spy points, health, happiness, maintenance and trade; Garden adds health/culture/Great People; Babylon Courthouse adds production, commerce, culture, happiness and Great People.
packages.unique_palace_improvement_or_dll_mechani: Unique Palace plus two further building replacements; no unique improvement.
packages.current_strengths: Law/administration and urban prosperity are strongly expressed and the earlier Hammurabi work is visible in live XML.
packages.overlap_or_redundancy: Three enhanced buildings plus a large Palace cause cumulative city-economy overlap; the culture-10 personality underplays administration and expansion.
packages.historical_fit: Law and centralized administration are strongly grounded; gardens are plausible Babylonian urban identity but should not eclipse the legal thesis.
packages.ai_and_art_risks: Mostly stock art, but custom palace/courthouse entries need render/help closure. Passive bonuses are AI-safe; the cumulative budget is the main risk.
packages.recommendation: Preserve all names and the legal identity, but consolidate or reduce duplicate Palace/Courthouse/Garden yields in one bounded balance pass.

packages.personality_theme: Peace-weight 2, military 5/gold 2, Free Market; opportunistic warfare, moderate razing and unit production.

packages.trait_effect_summary: TRAIT_ELIZABETH: +75% Great People rate and an extra-yield threshold of 2 in the live trait table.
packages.personality_theme: Peace-weight 9, gold 5/culture 2, Free Religion; very peaceful, low unit build and no razing.
packages.replacement_package_summary: One Sea Dog type is assigned as the Galley, Trireme and Privateer replacement; its live unit class is Privateer, with early Sailing/Metal Casting access, strength 6, three moves, cargo 4, bombard and mixed naval AIs. Royal Exchange is an early Guilds Bank with +5 gold and 65% gold.
packages.unique_palace_improvement_or_dll_mechani: No palace/improvement; multi-class civilization mapping to one UnitInfo is an unusual synchronization and AI contract.
packages.current_strengths: Naval defense, commerce and Great People create a strong Elizabethan maritime-economy identity.
packages.overlap_or_redundancy: The same unit replacing three eras/classes collapses naval progression and creates AI/upgrade ambiguity; Royal Exchange and trait are already powerful.
packages.historical_fit: Maritime defense, intelligence and commercial expansion fit Elizabeth I, but a single ship spanning galley through privateer is historically and mechanically blunt.
packages.ai_and_art_risks: High AI risk from conflicting class/default-AI/cargo roles; high art/animation test burden across three replacement contexts.
packages.recommendation: Keep the maritime thesis and Royal Exchange; redesign the Sea Dog mapping into one clear era/role or explicitly prove the multi-class contract.

packages.recommendation: No redesign; later tests should compare Russian cavalry packages.

packages.unique_palace_improvement_or_dll_mechani: Trait/promotion DLL support; no unique palace or improvement.

packages.historical_fit: Imperial expansion and road/infrastructure administration fit Huayna Capac.
packages.ai_and_art_risks: Stock core art is low risk; custom Worker/Settler art groups and noncombat promotions need animation/help checks. AI valuation of promoted civilian units is uncertain.
packages.recommendation: Retain the package; clarify the civilian promotion and remove a replacement only if it has no observable gameplay value.

packages.personality_theme: Peace-weight 1, science 5/military 2, Mercantilism; guarded, war-capable and low-espionage, with moderate unit production.

packages.ai_and_art_risks: Stock Samurai/leader art is low risk; Kamikaze prerequisite/help and Magistracy art still need gameplay smoke. AI understands XP and promotions.
packages.recommendation: No redesign; retain the earlier work and test its promotion stack.

packages.personality_theme: Peace-weight 8, gold 5/science 2, Caste System; peaceful but not helpless, with moderate espionage.

packages.recommendation: Keep Hwacha and one signature science building; use the next matrix to differentiate or normalize the other two rather than add a fourth mechanic.

packages.recommendation: Delete or replace the Japanese-improvement coupling and narrow the trait to mounted command/logistics.

packages.recommendation: Design anew around merchant diplomacy and expedition logistics, with one clear Merchant action and a normally budgeted Palace.

packages.trait_effect_summary: TRAIT_SHAKA: -50% XP threshold, +100% Great General rates; Pinch and Flanking I to melee and gun units.
packages.personality_theme: Peace-weight 2, military flavor 10, Police State; extremely frequent war, 40% unit build and 50% razing.
packages.replacement_package_summary: Two-move Mobility Impi; Ikhanda Barracks adds -20% maintenance.
packages.unique_palace_improvement_or_dll_mechani: Promotion tables use existing DLL support; no palace/improvement.
packages.current_strengths: Compact, powerful military expansion package with a real economic enabler.
packages.overlap_or_redundancy: Warmonger overlap is inevitable, but fast spear plus maintenance Barracks is unique.
packages.historical_fit: Regimental warfare and centralized military expansion fit the Shakan package.
packages.ai_and_art_risks: Stock art and highly aligned AI are low risk; promotion stack requires balance testing only.
packages.recommendation: No redesign.
